zh.title: SITA收購CAE航空運營軟體業務
zh.summary: SITA與CAE達成收購協議；交易預計2027年上半年完成
body: SITA已同意收購加拿大CAE的航空運營軟體業務Flightscape。根據聲明，該交易將擴展SITA在航空運營領域的角色。
Flightscape的軟體協助航空公司規劃航班、管理機組、運營控制、協調地面活動並提供機上服務。SITA表示，超過90家航空公司每日使用該系統。
交易預計於2027年上半年完成，需經常規關閉條件及監管批准。財務條款未在聲明中披露。

en.title: SITA Acquires CAE's Airline Operations Software Business
en.summary: SITA agrees to acquire CAE's Flightscape; deal expected to close in the first half of 2027
body: SITA has agreed to acquire Flightscape, CAE's airline operations software business. The deal will expand SITA's role in aviation operations.
Flightscape's software helps airlines plan flights, manage crews, operate control centers, coordinate ground activities, and deliver in-flight services. SITA states over 90 airlines use it daily.
The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals. Financial terms were not disclosed.
